title: Three-layer sender_msg_id idempotency: app check + UNIQUE INDEX + BEFORE INSERT trigger
description: Deduplication uses three independent guards: (1) app-level find_by_sender_msg_id before write, (2) UNIQUE INDEX messages_sender_msg_id on (chat_id, sender_msg_id), (3) BEFORE INSERT trigger aborting NULL sender_msg_id. Each catches a distinct failure mode the others don't. SQLite UNIQUE INDEX permits multiple NULLs, so removing the trigger would silently allow NULL-deduplication bypass. Future contributors should not remove any layer as 'redundant'.
